crossrefs.raw: 徒十一30，十四23，十五2，二十17，提前五17，19，多一5，雅五14

refs.text_gb: 他们就这样行了，由巴拿巴和扫罗经手，送到众长老那里。
refs.text_big5: 他們就這樣行了，由巴拿巴和掃羅經手，送到眾長老那裏。
refs.text_en: Which also they did, sending it to the elders through the hand of Barnabas and Saul.

refs.text_gb: 二人在各召会中为他们选立了长老，又禁食祷告，就把他们交托所信入的主。
refs.text_big5: 二人在各召會中為他們選立了長老，又禁食禱告，就把他們交託所信入的主。
refs.text_en: And when they had appointed elders for them in every church and had prayed with fastings, they committed them to the Lord into whom they had believed.

refs.text_gb: 保罗、巴拿巴与他们起了不小的争执和辩论，众人就指派保罗、巴拿巴、和他们其中的几个人，为所辩论的，上耶路撒冷去见使徒和长老。
refs.text_big5: 保羅、巴拿巴與他們起了不小的爭執和辯論，眾人就指派保羅、巴拿巴、和他們其中的幾個人，為所辯論的，上耶路撒冷去見使徒和長老。
refs.text_en: And when no little dissension and discussion with them came about through Paul and Barnabas, the brothers directed Paul and Barnabas and certain others among them to go up to the apostles and elders in Jerusalem concerning this question.

refs.text_gb: 保罗从米利都打发人往以弗所去，请召会的长老来。
refs.text_big5: 保羅從米利都打發人往以弗所去，請召會的長老來。
refs.text_en: And from Miletus he sent word to Ephesus and called for the elders of the church.

refs.text_gb: 那善于带领的长老，尤其是那在话语和教导上劳苦的，当被看为配受加倍的敬奉。
refs.text_big5: 那善於帶領的長老，尤其是那在話語和教導上勞苦的，當被看為配受加倍的敬奉。
refs.text_en: Let the elders who take the lead well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in word and teaching.

refs.text_gb: 对长老的控告，除非凭着两三个见证人，你不要接受。
refs.text_big5: 對長老的控告，除非憑著兩三個見證人，你不要接受。
refs.text_en: Against an elder do not receive an accusation, except at the mouth of two or three witnesses.

refs.text_gb: 我从前留你在革哩底，是要你将我所未办完的事办理妥当，又照我所吩咐你的，在各城设立长老。
refs.text_big5: 我從前留你在革哩底，是要你將我所未辦完的事辦理妥當，又照我所吩咐你的，在各城設立長老。
refs.text_en: For this cause I left you in Crete, that you might set in order the things which I have begun that remain and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you:

refs.text_gb: 你们中间有病弱的么？他该请召会的长老来，在主的名里用油抹他，为他祷告。
refs.text_big5: 你們中間有病弱的麼？他該請召會的長老來，在主的名裏用油抹他，為他禱告。
refs.text_en: Is anyone among you ill? Let him call for the elders of the church, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.

verses.text_gb: 务要[Fn1][Cra]牧养你们中间神的[Fn2][Crb]群羊，[Fn3]按着神[Fn4][Crc]监督他们，不是出于勉强，乃是出于[Crd]甘心；不是[Cre]为着卑鄙的利益，乃是出于热切；
verses.text_big5: 務要[Fn1][Cra]牧養你們中間神的[Fn2][Crb]群羊，[Fn3]按著神[Fn4][Crc]監督他們，不是出於勉強，乃是出於[Crd]甘心；不是[Cre]為著卑鄙的利益，乃是出於熱切；
verses.text_en: Shepherd the flock of God among you, overseeing not under compulsion but willingly, according to God; not by seeking gain through base means but eagerly;
verses.text_gb_plain: 务要牧养你们中间神的群羊，按着神监督他们，不是出于勉强，乃是出于甘心；不是为着卑鄙的利益，乃是出于热切；
verses.text_big5_plain: 務要牧養你們中間神的群羊，按著神監督他們，不是出於勉強，乃是出於甘心；不是為著卑鄙的利益，乃是出於熱切；

footnotes.zh: 牧养神的群羊，需要为基督的身体受苦，如基督所行的一样(西一24)。这会得着不能衰残的荣耀冠冕为赏赐(4)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 牧養神的群羊，需要為基督的身體受苦，如基督所行的一樣。（西一24。）這會得著不能衰殘的榮耀冠冕為賞賜。（4。）
footnotes.en: 5:2 1 Shepherd To shepherd the flock of God requires suffering for the Body of Christ as Christ suffered (Col. 1:24). This will be rewarded with the unfading crown of glory (v. 4).

footnotes.zh: 直译，小群。即神的召会(徒二十28)，与世人相比，为数较少(路十二32)。这小群的召会是作生命供应的小菜蔬，不是给飞鸟栖宿的大树(太十三31～32与注)，不是像基督教国那样庞大的宗教。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，小群。即神的召會，（徒二十28，）與世人相比，為數較少。（路十二32。）這小群的召會是作生命供應的小菜蔬，不是給飛鳥棲宿的大樹，（太十三31～32與註，）不是像基督教國那樣龐大的宗教。
footnotes.en: 5:2 2 flock Lit., little flock; i.e., the church of God (Acts 20:28), which is little in number (Luke 12:32) compared with the world. The church as the little flock is a little herb for the supply of life, not a big tree for birds to lodge in (Matt. 13:31-32 and notes), not a huge religion like Christendom.

footnotes.zh: 即按着神的性情、心意、作法和荣耀，不按着人的偏好、兴趣和目的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即按著神的性情、心意、作法和榮耀，不按著人的偏好、興趣和目的。
footnotes.en: 5:2 3 overseeing Taking the oversight, looking diligently to be aware of the situation.

footnotes.zh: 指殷勤留意，要晓得情况如何。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指殷勤留意，要曉得情況如何。
footnotes.en: 5:2 4 according I.e., according to God's nature, desire, way, and glory, not according to man's preference, interest, and purpose.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣第二次又对他说，约翰的儿子西门，你爱我么？彼得对祂说，主啊，是的，你知道我爱你。耶稣对他说，你牧养我的羊。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌第二次又對他說，約翰的兒子西門，你愛我麼？彼得對祂說，主阿，是的，你知道我愛你。耶穌對他說，你牧養我的羊。
refs.text_en: He said to him again a second time, Simon, son of John, do you love Me? He said to Him, Yes, Lord, You know that I love You. He said to him, Shepherd My sheep.

refs.text_gb: 祂必像牧人牧养自己的羊群，用膀臂聚集羊羔，抱在怀中。祂必引导那乳养小羊的。
refs.text_big5: 祂必像牧人牧養自己的羊群，用膀臂聚集羊羔，抱在懷中。祂必引導那乳養小羊的。
refs.text_en: He will feed His flock as a Shepherd; / In His arm He will gather the lambs; / In His bosom He will carry them. / He will lead those who are nursing the young.

refs.text_gb: 圣灵立你们作全群的监督，你们就当为自己谨慎，也为全群谨慎，牧养神的召会，就是祂用自己的血所买来的。
refs.text_big5: 聖靈立你們作全群的監督，你們就當為自己謹慎，也為全群謹慎，牧養神的召會，就是祂用自己的血所買來的。
refs.text_en: Take heed to yourselves and to all the flock, among whom the Holy Spirit has placed you as overseers to shepherd the church of God, which He obtained through His own blood.

refs.text_gb: 人若渴望得监督的职分，就是羡慕善工；这话是可信的。
refs.text_big5: 人若渴望得監督的職分，就是羨慕善工；這話是可信的。
refs.text_en: Faithful is the word: If anyone aspires to the overseership, he desires a good work.

refs.text_gb: 所以作监督的必须无可指责，只作一个妻子的丈夫，节制适度，清明自守，端正规矩，乐意待客，善于教导；
refs.text_big5: 所以作監督的必須無可指責，只作一個妻子的丈夫，節制適度，清明自守，端正規矩，樂意待客，善於教導；
refs.text_en: The overseer then must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, of a sober mind, orderly, hospitable, apt to teach;

refs.text_gb: 你们好像羊走迷了路，如今却归到你们魂的牧人和监督了。
refs.text_big5: 你們好像羊走迷了路，如今卻歸到你們魂的牧人和監督了。
refs.text_en: For you were like sheep being led astray, but you have now returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

refs.text_gb: 我若甘心作这事，就有赏赐；若不甘心，管家的职分却已经托付我了。
refs.text_big5: 我若甘心作這事，就有賞賜；若不甘心，管家的職分卻已經託付我了。
refs.text_en: If I do this of my own will, I have a reward; but if not of my own will, I am entrusted with a stewardship.

refs.text_gb: 不醉酒滋事，不打人，只要和蔼，不争竞，不贪财；
refs.text_big5: 不醉酒滋事，不打人，只要和藹，不爭競，不貪財；
refs.text_en: Not an excessive drinker; not a striker, but forbearing; not contentious; not fond of money;

refs.text_gb: 作执事的也是如此，必须庄重，不一口两舌，不酗酒成瘾，不贪卑鄙的利益；
refs.text_big5: 作執事的也是如此，必須莊重，不一口兩舌，不酗酒成癮，不貪卑鄙的利益；
refs.text_en: Deacons must similarly be grave, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for base gain;

refs.text_gb: 因为监督是神的管家，必须无可指责，不任性，不暴躁，不醉酒滋事，不打人，不贪卑鄙的利益；
refs.text_big5: 因為監督是神的管家，必須無可指責，不任性，不暴躁，不醉酒滋事，不打人，不貪卑鄙的利益；
refs.text_en: For the overseer must be unreprovable as a steward of God, not self-willed, not quick tempered, not an excessive drinker, not a striker, not greedy for base gain;

refs.text_gb: 离弃正路而走迷了，随从比珥之子巴兰的路；巴兰曾经贪爱不义的工价，
refs.text_big5: 離棄正路而走迷了，隨從比珥之子巴蘭的路；巴蘭曾經貪愛不義的工價，
refs.text_en: Forsaking the straight way, they have gone astray, following the way of Balaam, the son of Beor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness

verses.text_gb: 也不是[Fn1][Cra]作主辖管[Fn2]所委托你们的产业，乃是[Fn3]作[Fn4]群羊的[Crb]榜样。
verses.text_big5: 也不是[Fn1][Cra]作主轄管[Fn2]所委託你們的產業，乃是[Fn3]作[Fn4]群羊的[Crb]榜樣。
verses.text_en: Nor as lording it over your allotments but by becoming patterns of the flock.
verses.text_gb_plain: 也不是作主辖管所委托你们的产业，乃是作群羊的榜样。
verses.text_big5_plain: 也不是作主轄管所委託你們的產業，乃是作群羊的榜樣。

footnotes.zh: 指操权辖管被治理的人(太二十25)。在信徒中间，除了基督以外，不该有别的主；众人都该是仆人，甚至是奴仆(太二十26～27，二三10～11)。召会中的长老只能带领(不能作主)，所有的信徒都该敬重并跟随这带领(帖前五12，提前五17)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指操權轄管被治理的人。（太二十25。）在信徒中間，除了基督以外，不該有別的主；眾人都該是僕人，甚至是奴僕。（太二十26～27，二三10～11。）召會中的長老只能帶領，（不能作主，）所有的信徒都該敬重並跟隨這帶領。（帖前五12，提前五17。）
footnotes.en: 5:3 1 lording I.e., exercising lordship over the ruled (Matt. 20:25). Among the believers, besides Christ there should be no other lord; all should be servants, even slaves (Matt. 20:26-27; 23:10-11). The elders in the church can exercise only leadership (not lordship), which all the believers should honor and follow (1 Thes. 5:12; 1 Tim. 5:17).

footnotes.zh: 所委托你们的产业，原文指一分土地，或资产，因此是所分配的土地、委托的资产；这里是指下句的群羊。召会乃是神的产业，分配给长老作他们受托的资产，蒙神委托他们照管。
footnotes.zh_big5: 所委託你們的產業，原文指一分土地，或資產，因此是所分配的土地、委託的資產；這裏是指下句的群羊。召會乃是神的產業，分配給長老作他們受託的資產，蒙神委託他們照管。
footnotes.en: 5:3 2 allotments Lit., lots, portions; hence, allotments, portions entrusted, referring here to the flock mentioned in the following clause. The churches are God's possession, allotted to the elders as their allotment, their portion, entrusted to them by God for their care.

footnotes.zh: 即领头事奉并照管召会，使信徒可以跟随。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即領頭事奉並照管召會，使信徒可以跟隨。
footnotes.en: 5:3 3 becoming I.e., taking the lead to serve and care for the church, that the believers may follow.

footnotes.zh: 见2注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見2註2。
footnotes.en: 5:3 4 flock See note 2 2 .

refs.text_gb: 瘦弱的，你们没有养壮；有病的，你们没有医治；受伤的，你们没有缠裹；被逐的，你们没有领回；迷失的，你们没有寻找；但用强力严严地辖制。
refs.text_big5: 瘦弱的，你們沒有養壯；有病的，你們沒有醫治；受傷的，你們沒有纏裹；被逐的，你們沒有領回；迷失的，你們沒有尋找；但用強力嚴嚴的轄制。
refs.text_en: The weak you have not strengthened, and the sick one you have not healed, and the broken one you have not bound up, and the one that was driven away you have not brought back, and the lost one you have not sought; but with strength and rigor you have ruled over them.

refs.text_gb: 我们并不是作主管辖你们的信心，乃是与你们同工，使你们喜乐，因为你们是凭信而立。
refs.text_big5: 我們並不是作主管轄你們的信心，乃是與你們同工，使你們喜樂，因為你們是憑信而立。
refs.text_en: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers with you for your joy; for by faith you stand.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣叫他们来，对他们说，你们知道外邦人有尊为君王的，为主治理他们，也有大臣操权管辖他们。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌叫他們來，對他們說，你們知道外邦人有尊為君王的，為主治理他們，也有大臣操權管轄他們。
refs.text_en: And Jesus called them to Him and said to them, You know that those who are esteemed as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

refs.text_gb: 但你们中间不是这样；反倒你们中间无论谁想要为大，就必作你们的仆役；
refs.text_big5: 但你們中間不是這樣；反倒你們中間無論誰想要為大，就必作你們的僕役；
refs.text_en: But it is not so among you; but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant,

refs.text_gb: 你们中间无论谁想要为首，就必作众人的奴仆。
refs.text_big5: 你們中間無論誰想要為首，就必作眾人的奴僕。
refs.text_en: And whoever wants to be first among you shall be the slave of all.

crossrefs.label: b
crossrefs.raw: 帖后三9，提前四12，多二7，腓三17

refs.text_gb: 这并不是因我们没有权利，乃是要给你们作榜样，叫你们效法我们。
refs.text_big5: 這並不是因我們沒有權利，乃是要給你們作榜樣，叫你們效法我們。
refs.text_en: Not because we do not have the right, but in order that we might give ourselves to you as a pattern that you might imitate us.

refs.text_gb: 不可叫人小看你年轻，总要在言语、为人、爱、信、纯洁上，都作信徒的榜样。
refs.text_big5: 不可叫人小看你年輕，總要在言語、為人、愛、信、純潔上，都作信徒的榜樣。
refs.text_en: Let no one despise your youth, but be a pattern to the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.

refs.text_gb: 在凡事上你自己要显出善行的榜样，在教导上要不腐化，要庄重，
refs.text_big5: 在凡事上你自己要顯出善行的榜樣，在教導上要不腐化，要莊重，
refs.text_en: Concerning all things presenting yourself as a pattern of good works: in your teaching showing incorruption, gravity,

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，你们要一同效法我，你们怎样以我们为榜样，也当留意那些这样行的人。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，你們要一同效法我，你們怎樣以我們為榜樣，也當留意那些這樣行的人。
refs.text_en: Be imitators together of me, brothers, and observe those who thus walk even as you have us as a pattern.

verses.text_gb: 到了[Cra]牧长显现的时候，你们必得着那[Fn1][Crb]不能衰残的荣耀[Crc]冠冕。
verses.text_big5: 到了[Cra]牧長顯現的時候，你們必得著那[Fn1][Crb]不能衰殘的榮耀[Crc]冠冕。
verses.text_en: And when the Chief Shepherd is manifested, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.
verses.text_gb_plain: 到了牧长显现的时候，你们必得着那不能衰残的荣耀冠冕。
verses.text_big5_plain: 到了牧長顯現的時候，你們必得著那不能衰殘的榮耀冠冕。

footnotes.zh: 在使徒时代，冠冕乃是颁给在运动竞技中的胜利者(林前九25，提后四8)；那些是会朽坏的冠冕，其荣耀会衰残。主赐给忠信长老的冠冕，乃是对他们忠心事奉的赏赐。这冠冕的荣耀永不衰残，在神和基督的国(彼后一11)显现时，要成为得胜者所享受的一分荣耀。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在使徒時代，冠冕乃是頒給在運動競技中的勝利者；（林前九25，提後四8；）那些是會朽壞的冠冕，其榮耀會衰殘。主賜給忠信長老的冠冕，乃是對他們忠心事奉的賞賜。這冠冕的榮耀永不衰殘，在神和基督的國（彼後一11）顯現時，要成為得勝者所享受的一分榮耀。
footnotes.en: 5:4 1 unfading At the apostle's time crowns were given to victors in athletic games (1 Cor. 9:25; 2 Tim. 4:8). Those were corruptible crowns, whose glory faded. The crown given by the Lord to the faithful elders will be a reward for their loyal service. The glory of this crown will never fade. It will be a portion of the glory for the overcomers' enjoyment in the manifestation of the kingdom of God and Christ (2 Pet. 1:11).

refs.text_gb: 你们好像羊走迷了路，如今却归到你们魂的牧人和监督了。
refs.text_big5: 你們好像羊走迷了路，如今卻歸到你們魂的牧人和監督了。
refs.text_en: For you were like sheep being led astray, but you have now returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

refs.text_gb: 但愿平安的神，就是那凭永约之血，领群羊的大牧人我们的主耶稣，从死人中上来的，
refs.text_big5: 但願平安的神，就是那憑永約之血，領群羊的大牧人我們的主耶穌，從死人中上來的，
refs.text_en: Now the God of peace, He who brought up from the dead our Lord Jesus, the great Shepherd of the sheep, in the blood of an eternal covenant,

refs.text_gb: 我是好牧人，好牧人为羊舍命。
refs.text_big5: 我是好牧人，好牧人為羊捨命。
refs.text_en: I am the good Shepherd; the good Shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

refs.text_gb: 我是好牧人，我认识那属我的，那属我的也认识我，
refs.text_big5: 我是好牧人，我認識那屬我的，那屬我的也認識我，
refs.text_en: I am the good Shepherd, and I know My own, and My own know Me,

refs.text_gb: 可以得着不能朽坏、不能玷污、不能衰残，为你们存留在诸天之上的基业，
refs.text_big5: 可以得著不能朽壞、不能玷污、不能衰殘，為你們存留在諸天之上的基業，
refs.text_en: Unto an inheritance, incorruptible and undefiled and unfading, kept in the heavens for you,

crossrefs.label: c
crossrefs.raw: 林前九25，提后四8，雅一12，启二10，三11

refs.text_gb: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制；他们不过是要得能坏的华冠，我们却是要得不能坏的华冠。
refs.text_big5: 凡較力爭勝的，諸事都有節制；他們不過是要得能壞的華冠，我們卻是要得不能壞的華冠。
refs.text_en: And everyone who contends exercises self-control in all things; they then, that they may receive a corruptible crown, but we, an incorruptible.

refs.text_gb: 从此以后，有公义的冠冕为我存留，就是主，那公义的审判者，在那日要赏赐我的；不但赏赐我，也赏赐凡爱祂显现的人。
refs.text_big5: 從此以後，有公義的冠冕為我存留，就是主，那公義的審判者，在那日要賞賜我的；不但賞賜我，也賞賜凡愛祂顯現的人。
refs.text_en: Henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, with which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will recompense me in that day, and not only me but also all those who have loved His appearing.

refs.text_gb: 忍受试炼的人有福了，因为他既受试验得了称许，就必得着生命的冠冕，这是主应许给那些爱祂之人的。
refs.text_big5: 忍受試煉的人有福了，因為他既受試驗得了稱許，就必得著生命的冠冕，這是主應許給那些愛祂之人的。
refs.text_en: Blessed is the man who endures trial, because when he has become approved by testing, he will receive the crown of life, which He promised to those who love Him.

refs.text_gb: 你将要受的苦你不用怕。看哪，魔鬼将要把你们中间几个人下在监里，叫你们受试炼；你们必受患难十日。你务要至死忠信，我就赐给你那生命的冠冕。
refs.text_big5: 你將要受的苦你不用怕。看哪，魔鬼將要把你們中間幾個人下在監裏，叫你們受試煉；你們必受患難十日。你務要至死忠信，我就賜給你那生命的冠冕。
refs.text_en: Do not fear the things that you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to cast some of you into prison that you may be tried, and you will have tribulation for ten days. Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.

refs.text_gb: 我必快来，你要持守你所有的，免得有人夺去你的冠冕。
refs.text_big5: 我必快來，你要持守你所有的，免得有人奪去你的冠冕。
refs.text_en: I come quickly; hold fast what you have that no one take your crown.

verses.text_gb: 照样，[Cra]年幼的，要[Crb]服从[Fn1]年长的；你们众人彼此相待，也都要以[Fn2][Crc]谦卑[Fn3]束腰，因为神[Fn4][Crd]敌挡[Fn5][Cre]狂傲的人，[Crf]赐[Fn6][Crg]恩给[Fn7][Crh]谦卑的人。
verses.text_big5: 照樣，[Cra]年幼的，要[Crb]服從[Fn1]年長的；你們眾人彼此相待，也都要以[Fn2][Crc]謙卑[Fn3]束腰，因為神[Fn4][Crd]敵擋[Fn5][Cre]狂傲的人，[Crf]賜[Fn6][Crg]恩給[Fn7][Crh]謙卑的人。
verses.text_en: In like manner, younger men, be subject to elders; and all of you gird yourselves with humility toward one another, because God resists the proud but gives grace to the humble.
verses.text_gb_plain: 照样，年幼的，要服从年长的；你们众人彼此相待，也都要以谦卑束腰，因为神敌挡狂傲的人，赐恩给谦卑的人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 照樣，年幼的，要服從年長的；你們眾人彼此相待，也都要以謙卑束腰，因為神敵擋狂傲的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。

footnotes.zh: 虽然原文与1节的长老同字，但这里原则上该是指所有年长的人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 雖然原文與1節的長老同字，但這裏原則上該是指所有年長的人。
footnotes.en: 5:5 1 elders Although the Greek word is the same as in v. 1, it should, in principle, refer to all older men.

footnotes.zh: 或，卑微。与弗四2者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，卑微。與弗四2者同。
footnotes.en: 5:5 2 gird The Greek word is derived from a noun meaning a slave's apron; such an apron girded up the slave's loose garments in the service. It is used here as a figure of speech, signifying the putting on of humility as a virtue in service. This figure came evidently from Peter's impression of how the Lord girded Himself with a towel when He humbled Himself to wash the disciples' feet, especially Peter's (John 13:4-7). The thought of girding up had already been introduced by Peter in 1 Pet. 1:13.

footnotes.zh: 原文源自奴仆的围裙一辞，指服事时用以束紧宽松之外衣者，这里用作比喻，表征在服事时穿上谦卑为美德。这比喻显然是出于彼得的印象，就是主如何以手巾束腰，降卑自己洗门徒的脚，特别是洗彼得的脚(约十三4～7)。彼得在一13已经引进了束腰的思想。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文源自奴僕的圍裙一辭，指服事時用以束緊寬鬆之外衣者，這裏用作比喻，表徵在服事時穿上謙卑為美德。這比喻顯然是出於彼得的印象，就是主如何以手巾束腰，降卑自己洗門徒的腳，特別是洗彼得的腳。（約十三4～7。）彼得在一13已經引進了束腰的思想。
footnotes.en: 5:5 3 humility Or, lowliness; as in Eph. 4:2.

footnotes.zh: 为很强的字眼，用以说到军队预备抵抗仇敌。
footnotes.zh_big5: 為很強的字眼，用以說到軍隊豫備抵抗仇敵。
footnotes.en: 5:5 4 resists A strong word used for an army preparing to resist the enemy.

footnotes.zh: 直译，表现在(别人)上面的人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，表現在（別人）上面的人。
footnotes.en: 5:5 5 proud Lit., those having a show above (others).

footnotes.zh: 严格的说，恩典是指三一神自己作生命的供应，在谦卑的信徒里面繁增。见一2注12，四10注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 嚴格的說，恩典是指三一神自己作生命的供應，在謙卑的信徒裏面繁增。見一2註12，四10註2。
footnotes.en: 5:5 6 grace Referring, strictly, to the Triune God Himself as the life supply, which is multiplied in the humble believer. See note 1 Pet. 1:2 12 and note 1 Pet. 4:10 2 .

footnotes.zh: 或，卑微的。与太十一29者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，卑微的。與太十一29者同。
footnotes.en: 5:5 7 humble Or, lowly; as in Matt. 11:29.

refs.text_gb: 不可严责老年人，只要劝他如同父亲，劝青年人如同弟兄，
refs.text_big5: 不可嚴責老年人，只要勸他如同父親，勸青年人如同弟兄，
refs.text_en: Do not upbraid an elderly man, but exhort him as a father, younger men as brothers,

refs.text_gb: 劝青年人也是一样，要清明自守。
refs.text_big5: 勸青年人也是一樣，要清明自守。
refs.text_en: The younger men likewise exhort to be of a sober mind,

refs.text_gb: 父老们，我写信给你们，因为你们认识那从起初原有的。青年人，我写信给你们，因为你们胜了那恶者。小孩子们，我写信给你们，因为你们认识父。
refs.text_big5: 父老們，我寫信給你們，因為你們認識那從起初原有的。青年人，我寫信給你們，因為你們勝了那惡者。小孩子們，我寫信給你們，因為你們認識父。
refs.text_en: I write to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, young children, because you know the Father.

refs.text_gb: 父老们，我刚写信给你们，因为你们认识那从起初原有的。青年人，我刚写信给你们，因为你们刚强，神的话住在你们里面，你们也胜了那恶者。
refs.text_big5: 父老們，我剛寫信給你們，因為你們認識那從起初原有的。青年人，我剛寫信給你們，因為你們剛強，神的話住在你們裏面，你們也勝了那惡者。
refs.text_en: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong and the word of God abides in you and you have overcome the evil one.

refs.text_gb: 凭着敬畏基督，彼此服从：
refs.text_big5: 憑著敬畏基督，彼此服從：
refs.text_en: Being subject to one another in the fear of Christ:

refs.text_gb: 总之，你们众人都要心思一致，同情体恤，弟兄相爱，心存慈怜，心思卑微。
refs.text_big5: 總之，你們眾人都要心思一致，同情體恤，弟兄相愛，心存慈憐，心思卑微。
refs.text_en: And finally be all of the same mind, sympathetic, loving the brothers, tenderhearted, humble-minded;

refs.text_gb: 凡事都不私图好争，也不贪图虚荣，只要心思卑微，各人看别人比自己强；
refs.text_big5: 凡事都不私圖好爭，也不貪圖虛榮，只要心思卑微，各人看別人比自己強；
refs.text_en: Doing nothing by way of selfish ambition nor by way of vainglory, but in lowliness of mind considering one another more excellent than yourselves;

refs.text_gb: 凡事卑微、温柔、恒忍，在爱里彼此担就，
refs.text_big5: 凡事卑微、溫柔、恆忍，在愛裏彼此擔就，
refs.text_en: With all lowliness and meekness, with long-suffering, bearing one another in love,

refs.text_gb: 但祂赐更大的恩典；所以经上说，“神敌挡狂傲的人，赐恩给谦卑的人。”
refs.text_big5: 但祂賜更大的恩典；所以經上說，“神敵擋狂傲的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。”
refs.text_en: But He gives greater grace; therefore it says, "God resists the proud but gives grace to the humble."

refs.text_gb: 耶和华虽高，仍看顾低微的人；祂却从远处认出骄傲的人。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華雖高，仍看顧低微的人；祂卻從遠處認出驕傲的人。
refs.text_en: For though Jehovah is high, He regards the lowly; / And the haughty He knows from afar.

refs.text_gb: 祂讥诮那好讥诮的人，赐恩给谦卑的人。
refs.text_big5: 祂譏誚那好譏誚的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
refs.text_en: To scorners He is scornful, / But to the humble He gives grace.

refs.text_gb: 就是照着父神的先见被拣选，借着那灵得圣别，以致顺从耶稣基督，并蒙祂血所洒的人：愿恩典与平安，繁增的归与你们。
refs.text_big5: 就是照著父神的先見被揀選，藉著那靈得聖別，以致順從耶穌基督，並蒙祂血所灑的人：願恩典與平安，繁增的歸與你們。
refs.text_en: Chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father in the sanctification of the Spirit unto obedience and the sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

refs.text_gb: 各人要照所得的恩赐，将这恩赐彼此供应，作神诸般恩典的好管家。
refs.text_big5: 各人要照所得的恩賜，將這恩賜彼此供應，作神諸般恩典的好管家。
refs.text_en: Each one, as he has received a gift, ministering it among yourselves as good stewards of the varied grace of God.

refs.text_gb: 但那全般恩典的神，就是那曾在基督耶稣里召你们进入祂永远荣耀的，等你们暂受苦难之后，必要亲自成全你们，坚固你们，加强你们，给你们立定根基。
refs.text_big5: 但那全般恩典的神，就是那曾在基督耶穌裏召你們進入祂永遠榮耀的，等你們暫受苦難之後，必要親自成全你們，堅固你們，加強你們，給你們立定根基。
refs.text_en: But the God of all grace, He who has called you into His eternal glory in Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, will Himself perfect, establish, strengthen, and ground you.

refs.text_gb: 因为那至高至上、住在永远、名为圣者的如此说，我必住在至高至圣的所在，也与灵里痛悔卑微的人同居，要使卑微之人的灵苏醒，也使痛悔之人的心苏醒。
refs.text_big5: 因為那至高至上、住在永遠、名為聖者的如此說，我必住在至高至聖的所在，也與靈裏痛悔卑微的人同居，要使卑微之人的靈甦醒，也使痛悔之人的心甦醒。
refs.text_en: For thus says the high and exalted One, / Who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: / I will dwell in the high and holy place, / And with the contrite and lowly of spirit, / To revive the spirit of the lowly / And to revive the heart of the contrite.

verses.text_gb: 所以你们[Cra]要[Fn1][Crb]谦卑，服在神大能的[Crc]手下，使祂到了时候，可以[Fn2]叫你们[Crd]升高。
verses.text_big5: 所以你們[Cra]要[Fn1][Crb]謙卑，服在神大能的[Crc]手下，使祂到了時候，可以[Fn2]叫你們[Crd]升高。
verses.text_en: Therefore be humbled under the mighty hand of God that He may exalt you in due time,
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以你们要谦卑，服在神大能的手下，使祂到了时候，可以叫你们升高。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以你們要謙卑，服在神大能的手下，使祂到了時候，可以叫你們升高。

footnotes.zh: 原文为被动式，指明神使我们谦卑，这主要的是借着逼迫的苦难(10)。然而，这需要我们与神的工作合作；我们必须甘愿在神大能的手下成为谦卑、卑微的。因此说“要谦卑。”“谦卑”是被动的，而“要”是主动的。当神行动，在我们身上工作时，我们需要采取主动，让祂在我们身上工作；采取主动是主动的，让祂工作是被动的。这就是我们甘愿服在神的手下，神的手是有大能为我们作成一切的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文為被動式，指明神使我們謙卑，這主要的是藉著逼迫的苦難。（10。）然而，這需要我們與神的工作合作；我們必須甘願在神大能的手下成為謙卑、卑微的。因此說“要謙卑。”“謙卑”是被動的，而“要”是主動的。當神行動，在我們身上工作時，我們需要採取主動，讓祂在我們身上工作；採取主動是主動的，讓祂工作是被動的。這就是我們甘願服在神的手下，神的手是有大能為我們作成一切的。
footnotes.en: 5:6 1 humbled In Greek the word is in the passive voice, indicating being made humble by God, mainly through sufferings in persecution (v. 10). This, however, requires that we cooperate with God's operation; we must be willing to be made humble, lowly, under the mighty hand of God. Hence, be humbled. Humbled is passive, but be is active. While God is acting to operate on us, we need to take the initiative to be operated on by Him. To take the initiative is active; to be operated on is passive. This is our willingness to be under the hand of God, which is mighty to do everything for us.

footnotes.zh: 服从神大能的手，甘愿成为卑微的，就是接受叫神得尊荣的作法，让祂有立场在祂的时候叫我们升高。甘愿让神使人降卑的手在祂的管教里叫我们卑微，乃是让神那使人升高的手在祂的得荣里叫我们升高的先决条件。
footnotes.zh_big5: 服從神大能的手，甘願成為卑微的，就是接受叫神得尊榮的作法，讓祂有立場在祂的時候叫我們升高。甘願讓神使人降卑的手在祂的管教裏叫我們卑微，乃是讓神那使人升高的手在祂的得榮裏叫我們升高的先決條件。
footnotes.en: 5:6 2 exalt To be submissive to God's mighty hand, to be willing to be made lowly, is to take the God-honoring way that gives Him the ground to exalt us in His time. To be willing to be made low by God's humbling hand in His discipline is a prerequisite to being made high by God's exalting hand in His glorification.

refs.text_gb: 所以你们要服从神，抵挡魔鬼，魔鬼就必离开你们逃跑了。
refs.text_big5: 所以你們要服從神，抵擋魔鬼，魔鬼就必離開你們逃跑了。
refs.text_en: Be subject therefore to God; but withstand the devil, and he will flee from you.

refs.text_gb: 人的骄傲必使他降卑，灵里谦卑的必得尊荣。
refs.text_big5: 人的驕傲必使他降卑，靈裏謙卑的必得尊榮。
refs.text_en: A man's pride will bring him low, / But he who is of a lowly spirit will obtain honor.

crossrefs.label: c
crossrefs.raw: 诗八九13，一三六12，赛五25，四十10

refs.text_gb: 你有大能的膀臂；你的手有力，你的右手也高举。
refs.text_big5: 你有大能的膀臂；你的手有力，你的右手也高舉。
refs.text_en: You have an arm with might; / Your hand is strong; Your right hand is high.

refs.text_gb: 祂用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，领他们出来，因祂的慈爱永远长存；
refs.text_big5: 祂用大能的手和伸出來的膀臂，領他們出來，因祂的慈愛永遠長存；
refs.text_en: With a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, / For His lovingkindness is forever;

refs.text_gb: 所以耶和华的怒气向祂的百姓发作，祂的手伸出击打他们。山岭震动，他们的尸首在街市上好像粪土。虽然如此，祂的怒气还未转消，祂的手仍然伸出。
refs.text_big5: 所以耶和華的怒氣向祂的百姓發作，祂的手伸出擊打他們。山嶺震動，他們的屍首在街市上好像糞土。雖然如此，祂的怒氣還未轉消，祂的手仍然伸出。
refs.text_en: For this reason the anger of Jehovah burns against His people, / And He stretches out His hand over them and strikes them. / And the mountains quake, and their corpses are / Like garbage in the middle of the street. / In spite of all this His anger is not turned away; / Rather, His hand is still stretched out.

refs.text_gb: 看哪，主耶和华必像大能者临到，祂的膀臂必为祂掌权。看哪，祂的赏赐在祂那里，祂的报应在祂面前。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，主耶和華必像大能者臨到，祂的膀臂必為祂掌權。看哪，祂的賞賜在祂那裏，祂的報應在祂面前。
refs.text_en: Behold, the Lord Jehovah will come as a mighty One, / And His arm will rule for Him. / Behold, His reward is with Him, / And His recompense before Him.

refs.text_gb: 因为凡高抬自己的，必降为卑；降卑自己的，必升为高。
refs.text_big5: 因為凡高抬自己的，必降為卑；降卑自己的，必升為高。
refs.text_en: For everyone who exalts himself shall be humbled, and he who humbles himself shall be exalted.

refs.text_gb: 我告诉你们，这人回家去，得称为义，那人却不然。因为凡高抬自己的，必降为卑；降卑自己的，必升为高。
refs.text_big5: 我告訴你們，這人回家去，得稱為義，那人卻不然。因為凡高抬自己的，必降為卑；降卑自己的，必升為高。
refs.text_en: I tell you, This man went down to his house justified rather than that one; for everyone who exalts himself shall be humbled, but he who humbles himself shall be exalted.

verses.text_gb: 你们要将[Fn1]一切的[Fn2][Cra]忧虑[Fn3][Crb]卸给神，因为祂[Fn4]顾念你们。
verses.text_big5: 你們要將[Fn1]一切的[Fn2][Cra]憂慮[Fn3][Crb]卸給神，因為祂[Fn4]顧念你們。
verses.text_en: Casting all your anxiety on Him because it matters to Him concerning you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们要将一切的忧虑卸给神，因为祂顾念你们。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要將一切的憂慮卸給神，因為祂顧念你們。

footnotes.zh: 即一生全部的忧虑，整个人生及其一切忧虑。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即一生全部的憂慮，整個人生及其一切憂慮。
footnotes.en: 5:7 1 Casting Or, throwing...upon; i.e., committing... to, giving up...to. The tense of the verb indicates a once-for-all act.

footnotes.zh: 或，担忧，挂虑。在逼迫中，信徒的苦难使他们担忧挂虑。他们不仅需要成为谦卑的，从狂傲、高傲被带到低微，更要将他们的一生及其忧虑卸给神，因为祂对他们不仅是大能、公义的，也是慈爱、信实的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，擔憂，罣慮。在逼迫中，信徒的苦難使他們擔憂罣慮。他們不僅需要成為謙卑的，從狂傲、高傲被帶到低微，更要將他們的一生及其憂慮卸給神，因為祂對他們不僅是大能、公義的，也是慈愛、信實的。
footnotes.en: 5:7 2 all I.e., the whole lot of your anxiety throughout your entire life, the whole life with all its anxiety.

footnotes.zh: 或，抛给神。即交托与神、让给神。这动词的时态指明一劳永逸的举动。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，拋給神。即交託與神、讓給神。這動詞的時態指明一勞永逸的舉動。
footnotes.en: 5:7 3 anxiety Or, worry, care. The sufferings experienced by the believers in their persecution cause them to worry and be anxious. They need not only to be humbled, to be brought low from their pride, their haughtiness, but also to throw their life with its care upon God; for He is not only mighty and just but also loving and faithful concerning them.

footnotes.zh: 或，关心。管教并审判人的神对信徒，特别对受逼迫者有爱的关切，祂信实的顾念他们。他们能将忧虑卸给祂，特别是在受逼迫的时候。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，關心。管教並審判人的神對信徒，特別對受逼迫者有愛的關切，祂信實的顧念他們。他們能將憂慮卸給祂，特別是在受逼迫的時候。
footnotes.en: 5:7 4 it Or, He cares for you. The disciplining and judging God has a loving concern for the believers, especially the persecuted ones. He cares for them faithfully. They can throw their care on Him, especially in their persecution.

refs.text_gb: 所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑，吃什么，喝什么；也不要为身体忧虑，穿什么。生命不胜于食物么？身体不胜于衣服么？
refs.text_big5: 所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮，喫甚麼，喝甚麼；也不要為身體憂慮，穿甚麼。生命不勝於食物麼？身體不勝於衣服麼？
refs.text_en: Because of this, I say to you, Do not be anxious for your life, what you should eat or what you should drink; nor for your body, what you should put on. Is not the life more than food, and the body than clothing?

refs.text_gb: 应当一无挂虑，只要凡事借着祷告、祈求，带着感谢，将你们所要的告诉神；
refs.text_big5: 應當一無罣慮，只要凡事藉著禱告、祈求，帶著感謝，將你們所要的告訴神；
refs.text_en: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God;

refs.text_gb: 你要把你的重担卸给耶和华，祂必扶持你；祂永不叫义人动摇。
refs.text_big5: 你要把你的重擔卸給耶和華，祂必扶持你；祂永不叫義人動搖。
refs.text_en: Cast your burden upon Jehovah, / And He will sustain you; / He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

verses.text_gb: 务要[Fn1][Cra]谨守、[Fn2][Crb]儆醒。你们的[Fn3][Crc]对头[Fn4][Crd]魔鬼，如同[Fn5]吼叫的[Cre]狮子，[Fn6]遍地[Crf]游行，[Fn7]寻找可吞吃的人；
verses.text_big5: 務要[Fn1][Cra]謹守、[Fn2][Crb]儆醒。你們的[Fn3][Crc]對頭[Fn4][Crd]魔鬼，如同[Fn5]吼叫的[Cre]獅子，[Fn6]遍地[Crf]遊行，[Fn7]尋找可吞喫的人；
verses.text_en: Be sober; watch. Your adversary, the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking someone to devour.
verses.text_gb_plain: 务要谨守、儆醒。你们的对头魔鬼，如同吼叫的狮子，遍地游行，寻找可吞吃的人；
verses.text_big5_plain: 務要謹守、儆醒。你們的對頭魔鬼，如同吼叫的獅子，遍地遊行，尋找可吞喫的人；

footnotes.zh: 谨守就是有清明、谨慎、自制的心思，使我们晓得神管教我们的目的，以及仇敌要毁坏我们的诡计，特别如本章所启示的。见四7注3。
footnotes.zh_big5: 謹守就是有清明、謹慎、自制的心思，使我們曉得神管教我們的目的，以及仇敵要毀壞我們的詭計，特別如本章所啟示的。見四7註3。
footnotes.en: 5:8 1 sober To be sober is to have a clear mind of sobriety and self-control that we may know, especially as disclosed in this chapter, God's purpose in disciplining us and His enemy's scheme to destroy us. See note note 1 Pet. 4:7 3 .

footnotes.zh: 儆醒犹如战争中的警备，如同在前线的士兵。这里特指儆醒抵挡仇敌所带给在逼迫中受苦信徒的忧虑。
footnotes.zh_big5: 儆醒猶如戰爭中的警備，如同在前線的士兵。這裏特指儆醒抵擋仇敵所帶給在逼迫中受苦信徒的憂慮。
footnotes.en: 5:8 2 watch To watch is to be vigilant as in warfare, as with soldiers on the frontier. Here it refers especially to the suffering believers' being watchful against the anxiety that the enemy brings in while they suffer persecution.

footnotes.zh: 直译，(诉讼中的)敌对者。这里是指控告我们的撒但(启十二9～10，9注4)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，（訴訟中的）敵對者。這裏是指控告我們的撒但。（啟十二9～10，9註4。）
footnotes.en: 5:8 3 adversary Lit., an opponent (in a lawsuit); referring here to Satan, who is our accuser (Rev. 12:9-10 and note Rev. 12:9 4 ).

footnotes.zh: 见太四1注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見太四1註2。
footnotes.en: 5:8 4 devil See note Matt. 4:1 3 .

footnotes.zh: 在饥饿中咆哮。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在飢餓中咆哮。
footnotes.en: 5:8 5 roaring Howling in hunger.

footnotes.zh: 这指明魔鬼不断积极的搜寻猎物。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明魔鬼不斷積極的搜尋獵物。
footnotes.en: 5:8 6 walks This indicates the devil's constant and aggressive activity in seeking prey.

footnotes.zh: 这里彼得警告在逼迫中受苦的信徒，他们若不肯谦卑，服在神大能的手下(6)，将忧虑卸给神(7)，他们就会被对头魔鬼，这吼叫的狮子所吞吃。这教训我们，狂傲和忧虑会使我们成为丰美的猎物，满足吼叫狮子的饥饿。无疑的，彼得在这方面无法忘记主说到魔鬼的愿望时，所给他的警告(路二二31)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏彼得警告在逼迫中受苦的信徒，他們若不肯謙卑，服在神大能的手下，（6，）將憂慮卸給神，（7，）他們就會被對頭魔鬼，這吼叫的獅子所吞喫。這教訓我們，狂傲和憂慮會使我們成為豐美的獵物，滿足吼叫獅子的飢餓。無疑的，彼得在這方面無法忘記主說到魔鬼的願望時，所給他的警告。（路二二31。）
footnotes.en: 5:8 7 seeking Peter here warned the believers who were suffering in persecution. If they would not be humbled under God's mighty hand (v. 6) and cast their anxiety on God (v. 7), they would be devoured by the roaring lion, the devil, their adversary. This teaches us that pride and anxiety make us delicious prey to satisfy the hunger of the roaring lion. In this matter Peter no doubt could not forget the Lord's warning to him regarding the devil's desire (Luke 22:31).

refs.text_gb: 所以要束上你们心思的腰，谨慎自守，全然寄望于耶稣基督显现的时候，所带给你们的恩。
refs.text_big5: 所以要束上你們心思的腰，謹慎自守，全然寄望於耶穌基督顯現的時候，所帶給你們的恩。
refs.text_en: Therefore girding up the loins of your mind and being sober, set your hope perfectly on the grace being brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

refs.text_gb: 所以我们不要睡觉，像其余的人一样，总要儆醒谨守。
refs.text_big5: 所以我們不要睡覺，像其餘的人一樣，總要儆醒謹守。
refs.text_en: So then let us not sleep as the rest do, but let us watch and be sober.

refs.text_gb: 但我们既是属于白昼，就当谨慎自守，穿上信和爱的胸甲，并戴上救恩之望的头盔。
refs.text_big5: 但我們既是屬於白晝，就當謹慎自守，穿上信和愛的胸甲，並戴上救恩之望的頭盔。
refs.text_en: But since we are of the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love and a helmet, the hope of salvation.

crossrefs.label: b
crossrefs.raw: 太二四42，二六41，路二一36，弗六18

refs.text_gb: 所以你们要儆醒，因为不知道你们的主那一天要来。
refs.text_big5: 所以你們要儆醒，因為不知道你們的主那一天要來。
refs.text_en: Watch therefore, for you do not know on what day your Lord comes.

refs.text_gb: 要儆醒祷告，免得入了试诱；你们的灵固然愿意，肉体却软弱了。
refs.text_big5: 要儆醒禱告，免得入了試誘；你們的靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。
refs.text_en: Watch and pray that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.

refs.text_gb: 但你们要时时儆醒，常常祈求，使你们得胜，能逃避这一切要发生的事，得以站立在人子面前。
refs.text_big5: 但你們要時時儆醒，常常祈求，使你們得勝，能逃避這一切要發生的事，得以站立在人子面前。
refs.text_en: But be watchful at every time, beseeching that you would prevail to escape all these things which are about to happen and stand before the Son of Man.

refs.text_gb: 时时在灵里祷告，并尽力坚持，在这事上儆醒，且为众圣徒祈求，
refs.text_big5: 時時在靈裏禱告，並盡力堅持，在這事上儆醒，且為眾聖徒祈求，
refs.text_en: By means of all prayer and petition, praying at every time in spirit and watching unto this in all perseverance and petition concerning all the saints,

refs.text_gb: 及至人们睡觉的时候，他的仇敌来了，将稗子撒在麦子中间，就走了。
refs.text_big5: 及至人們睡覺的時候，他的仇敵來了，將稗子撒在麥子中間，就走了。
refs.text_en: But while the men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares in the midst of the wheat and went away.

refs.text_gb: 也不可给魔鬼留地步。
refs.text_big5: 也不可給魔鬼留地步。
refs.text_en: Neither give place to the devil.

refs.text_gb: 要穿戴神全副的军装，使你们能以站住，抵挡魔鬼的诡计，
refs.text_big5: 要穿戴神全副的軍裝，使你們能以站住，抵擋魔鬼的詭計，
refs.text_en: Put on the whole armor of God that you may be able to stand against the stratagems of the devil,

refs.text_gb: 所以你们要服从神，抵挡魔鬼，魔鬼就必离开你们逃跑了。
refs.text_big5: 所以你們要服從神，抵擋魔鬼，魔鬼就必離開你們逃跑了。
refs.text_en: Be subject therefore to God; but withstand the devil, and he will flee from you.

refs.text_gb: 大龙就被摔下去，它是那古蛇，名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，是迷惑普天下的，它被摔在地上，它的使者也一同被摔下去。
refs.text_big5: 大龍就被摔下去，牠是那古蛇，名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，是迷惑普天下的，牠被摔在地上，牠的使者也一同被摔下去。
refs.text_en: And the great dragon was cast down, the ancient serpent, he who is called the Devil and Satan, he who deceives the whole inhabited earth; he was cast to the earth, and his angels were cast down with him.

refs.text_gb: 所以诸天和住在其中的，你们都要欢乐。只是地与海有祸了，因为魔鬼晓得自己的时候不多，就大大发怒下到你们那里去了。
refs.text_big5: 所以諸天和住在其中的，你們都要歡樂。只是地與海有禍了，因為魔鬼曉得自己的時候不多，就大大發怒下到你們那裏去了。
refs.text_en: Therefore be glad, O heavens and those who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and the sea because the devil has come down to you and has great rage, knowing that he has only a short time.

refs.text_gb: 撒但回答耶和华说，约伯敬畏神，岂是无故呢？
refs.text_big5: 撒但回答耶和華說，約伯敬畏神，豈是無故呢？
refs.text_en: Then Satan answered Jehovah and said, Does Job fear God without cause?

refs.text_gb: 你岂不是四面圈上篱笆围护他和他的家，并他一切所有的么？他手所作的，你都赐福；他的家产也在地上大大增多。
refs.text_big5: 你豈不是四面圈上籬笆圍護他和他的家，並他一切所有的麼？他手所作的，你都賜福；他的家產也在地上大大增多。
refs.text_en: Have You not set a hedge around him and his household and all that he has? You have blessed the work of his hands, so that his possessions are spread throughout the land.

refs.text_gb: 你且伸手，碰他一切所有的，他必当面咒诅你。
refs.text_big5: 你且伸手，碰他一切所有的，他必當面咒詛你。
refs.text_en: But stretch forth Your hand and touch all that he has, and he will surely curse You to Your face.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对撒但说，看哪，凡他所有的，都在你手中；只是不可伸手加害于他。于是撒但从耶和华面前退去。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對撒但說，看哪，凡他所有的，都在你手中；只是不可伸手加害於他。於是撒但從耶和華面前退去。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Satan, Here is all that he has, in your hand; only do not stretch forth your hand against him. And Satan went forth from Jehovah's presence.

refs.text_gb: 西门，西门，看哪，撒但想要得着你们，好筛你们像麦子一样。
refs.text_big5: 西門，西門，看哪，撒但想要得著你們，好篩你們像麥子一樣。
refs.text_en: Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has asked to have you all to sift you as wheat.

refs.text_gb: 免得我们给撒但占了便宜，因我们并非不晓得他的阴谋。
refs.text_big5: 免得我們給撒但佔了便宜，因我們並非不曉得他的陰謀。
refs.text_en: That we may not be taken advantage of by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

refs.text_gb: 他们向我张口，好像抓撕吼叫的狮子。
refs.text_big5: 他們向我張口，好像抓撕吼叫的獅子。
refs.text_en: They open their mouth at me, / Like a ravening and roaring lion.

refs.text_gb: 救我脱离狮子的口；求你应允我，使我脱离野牛的角。
refs.text_big5: 救我脫離獅子的口；求你應允我，使我脫離野牛的角。
refs.text_en: Save me from the mouth of the lion; / Indeed while I am in the horns of wild oxen, answer me.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华问撒但说，你从哪里来？撒但回答说，我从地上走来走去，往返而来。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華問撒但說，你從那裏來？撒但回答說，我從地上走來走去，往返而來。
refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Satan, Where have you come from? And Satan answered Jehovah and said, From roving the earth and going about in it.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华问撒但说，你从哪里来？撒但回答说，我从地上走来走去，往返而来。

refs.text_en: And Jehovah said to Satan, Where have you come from? And Satan answered Jehovah and said, From roving the earth and going about in it.

refs.text_en: For even though I am absent in the flesh, yet in the spirit I am with you, rejoicing and seeing your order and the solid basis of your faith in Christ.

refs.text_gb: 所以那照神旨意受苦的人，也要在善行上，将他们的魂交与那信实的创造主。
refs.text_big5: 所以那照神旨意受苦的人，也要在善行上，將他們的魂交與那信實的創造主。
refs.text_en: So then let those also who suffer according to the will of God commit their souls in well-doing to a faithful Creator.

refs.text_en: Establishing the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith and saying that through many tribulations we must enter into the kingdom of God.

refs.text_en: That no one would be shaken by these afflictions; for you yourselves know that we are appointed for this.

verses.text_en: But the God of all grace, He who has called you into His eternal glory in Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, will Himself perfect, establish, strengthen, and ground you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但那全般恩典的神，就是那曾在基督耶稣里召你们进入祂永远荣耀的，等你们暂受苦难之后，必要亲自成全你们，坚固你们，加强你们，给你们立定根基。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但那全般恩典的神，就是那曾在基督耶穌裏召你們進入祂永遠榮耀的，等你們暫受苦難之後，必要親自成全你們，堅固你們，加強你們，給你們立定根基。

footnotes.zh: 但，指明对比，给受苦的信徒带来安慰和鼓励。你们和你们的众弟兄受到你们对头的威吓，就是魔鬼如同狮子的吼叫，不过是暂时的，但那全般恩典的神，就是超过你们一切的需要，有全备充裕生命供应的神，必成全你们，坚固你们，加强你们，给你们立定根基。
footnotes.zh_big5: 但，指明對比，給受苦的信徒帶來安慰和鼓勵。你們和你們的眾弟兄受到你們對頭的威嚇，就是魔鬼如同獅子的吼叫，不過是暫時的，但那全般恩典的神，就是超過你們一切的需要，有全備充裕生命供應的神，必成全你們，堅固你們，加強你們，給你們立定根基。
footnotes.en: 5:10 1 But Here but, indicating a contrast, brings in a word of comfort and encouragement to the suffering believers: You and your brotherhood are suffering your adversary's threatening, the devil's lion-roar, for only a little while, but the God of all grace, of the bountiful and gracious supply of life that exceeds all your need, will perfect, establish, strengthen, and ground you.

footnotes.zh: 全般恩典是指在神的经纶里，按着在我们身上及里面神圣工作的许多步骤，供应给我们神圣生命多面全备供应的丰富。开头的一步是呼召我们，终结的一步是叫我们得荣耀，正如这里所说，召你们得享祂永远的荣耀。在这两步之间，是祂管教我们时爱的关切，以及祂在我们身上成全、坚固、加强并立基的工作。在这一切神圣的举动里，神圣生命全备的供应就作恩典在各样的经历中供应我们(见一2注12，四10注2)。遭逼迫的信徒暂受苦难之后，这样恩典的神必要成全他们，坚固他们，加强他们，给他们立定根基。
footnotes.zh_big5: 全般恩典是指在神的經綸裏，按著在我們身上及裏面神聖工作的許多步驟，供應給我們神聖生命多面全備供應的豐富。開頭的一步是呼召我們，終結的一步是叫我們得榮耀，正如這裏所說，召你們進入祂永遠的榮耀。在這兩步之間，是祂管教我們時愛的關切，以及祂在我們身上成全、堅固、加強並立基的工作。在這一切神聖的舉動裏，神聖生命全備的供應就作恩典在各樣的經歷中供應我們。（見一2註12，四10註2。）遭逼迫的信徒暫受苦難之後，這樣恩典的神必要成全他們，堅固他們，加強他們，給他們立定根基。
footnotes.en: 5:10 2 all All grace refers to the riches of the bountiful supply of the divine life in many aspects ministered to us in many steps of the divine operation on and in us in God's economy. The initial step is to call us, and the consummate step is to glorify us, as mentioned here in who has called you into His eternal glory. Between these two steps are God's loving care while He is disciplining us, and His perfecting, establishing, strengthening, and grounding work in us. In all these divine acts, the bountiful supply of the divine life is ministered to us as grace in varied experiences (see note 1 Pet. 1:2 12 and note 1 Pet. 4:10 2 ). The God of such grace will perfect, establish, strengthen, and ground the persecuted believers after they have suffered a little while.

footnotes.zh: 在基督耶稣里，指明那全般恩典的神经过成为肉体、为人生活、钉十字架、复活并升天的过程，成就完备且完满的救赎，使祂能将祂所救赎的人带进与祂自己生机的联结里。这样他们就能有分于三一神的丰富作他们的享受。神圣工作的一切步骤都是在基督里，祂是三一神的具体化身，成了包罗万有赐生命的灵，作我们全备的生命供应。在这基督里，借着祂包罗万有的救赎，并基于祂一切的成就，神就能成为全般恩典的神，召我们得享祂永远的荣耀，并在那作稳固根基的三一神(一2)里成全我们，坚固我们，加强我们，给我们立定根基，这样就使我们能达到祂荣耀的目标。堕落的罪人竟能被带进神永远的荣耀里，这是何等的神迹！祂在我们身上成全、坚固、加强并立基的工作又是何其超绝！这都是借祂全般的恩典，也就是真实的恩典(12)所成就的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在基督耶穌裏，指明那全般恩典的神經過成為肉體、為人生活、釘十字架、復活並升天的過程，成就完備且完滿的救贖，使祂能將祂所救贖的人帶進與祂自己生機的聯結裏。這樣他們就能有分於三一神的豐富作他們的享受。神聖工作的一切步驟都是在基督裏，祂是三一神的具體化身，成了包羅萬有賜生命的靈，作我們全備的生命供應。在這基督裏，藉著祂包羅萬有的救贖，並基於祂一切的成就，神就能成為全般恩典的神，召我們得享祂永遠的榮耀，並在那作穩固根基的三一神（一2）裏成全我們，堅固我們，加強我們，給我們立定根基，這樣就使我們能達到祂榮耀的目標。墮落的罪人竟能被帶進神永遠的榮耀裏，這是何等的神蹟！祂在我們身上成全、堅固、加強、並立基的工作又是何其超絕！這都是藉祂全般的恩典，也就是真實的恩典（12）所成就的。
footnotes.en: 5:10 3 into I.e., to partake of, to participate in.

footnotes.zh: 进入，意即有分于，得享。
footnotes.zh_big5: 進入，意即有分於，得享。
footnotes.en: 5:10 4 in In Christ Jesus indicates that the God of all grace went through all the processes of incarnation, human living, crucifixion, resurrection, and ascension to accomplish the complete and full redemption that He may bring His redeemed people into an organic union with Himself. Thus they can participate in the riches of the Triune God as their enjoyment. All the steps of the divine operation are in Christ, who is the embodiment of the Triune God and who became the all-inclusive life-giving Spirit as the bountiful life supply to us. It is in this Christ, through His all-inclusive redemption and based on all His achievements, that God can be the God of all grace to call us into His eternal glory and to perfect, establish, strengthen, and ground us in the Triune God (1 Pet. 1:1-2) as the solid foundation, thus enabling us to attain His glorious goal. What a miracle that fallen sinners could be brought into God's eternal glory! And how excellent is His perfecting, establishing, strengthening, and grounding work in us! This is all accomplished through His "all grace," which is the "true grace" (v. 12).

footnotes.en: 5:10 8 strengthen Its meaning is very close to establish.

footnotes.zh: 原文这辞源自“根基；”因此，是扎实的立定根基，与太七25，弗三17，来一10者同。恩典的四项神圣举动是有进展的。成全带来坚固，坚固带来加强，加强带来在全般恩典的神里立定根基。全般恩典的神，就是在祂的分赐里作稳固根基的三一神(一2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文這辭源自“根基；”因此，是扎實的立定根基，與太七25，弗三17，來一10者同。恩典的四項神聖舉動是有進展的。成全帶來堅固，堅固帶來加強，加強帶來在全般恩典的神裏立定根基。全般恩典的神，就是在祂的分賜裏作穩固根基的三一神。（一2。）
footnotes.en: 5:10 9 ground Derived from the word that means foundation. Hence, it means to ground solidly, as in Matt. 7:25, Eph. 3:17, and Heb. 1:10. There is a progression in the four divine acts of grace. Perfecting leads to establishing, establishing to strengthening, and strengthening to grounding in the God of all grace — the Triune God in His dispensing (1 Pet. 1:2) as the solid foundation.

refs.text_gb: 你们要用爱心的亲嘴彼此问安。愿平安归与你们凡在基督里的人。
refs.text_big5: 你們要用愛心的親嘴彼此問安。願平安歸與你們凡在基督裏的人。
refs.text_en: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to you all who are in Christ.

refs.text_gb: 且要带着温柔和敬畏，存着无亏的良心，叫你们在何事上被毁谤，就在何事上，可以叫那诬赖你们的人，因你们在基督里的好品行，感到羞愧。
refs.text_big5: 且要帶著溫柔和敬畏，存著無虧的良心，叫你們在何事上被毀謗，就在何事上，可以叫那誣賴你們的人，因你們在基督裏的好品行，感到羞愧。
refs.text_en: Yet with meekness and fear, having a good conscience, so that in the matter in which you are spoken against, those who revile your good manner of life in Christ may be put to shame.

refs.text_gb: 却要照着那呼召你们的圣者，在一切行事为人上，也成为圣的；
refs.text_big5: 卻要照著那呼召你們的聖者，在一切行事為人上，也成為聖的；
refs.text_en: But according to the Holy One who called you, you yourselves also be holy in all your manner of life;

refs.text_gb: 神的神能，借着我们充分认识那用祂自己的荣耀和美德呼召我们的，已将一切关于生命和敬虔的事赐给我们。

refs.text_en: So that you might walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.

refs.text_gb: 你要为信仰打那美好的仗，持定永远的生命；你已蒙召进入这永远的生命，也在许多见证人面前，作了美好的承认。
refs.text_big5: 你要為信仰打那美好的仗，持定永遠的生命；你已蒙召進入這永遠的生命，也在許多見證人面前，作了美好的承認。

refs.text_big5: 所以我為選民凡事忍耐，叫他們也可以得著那在基督耶穌裏的救恩，同永遠的榮耀。
refs.text_en: Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the chosen ones, that they themselves also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

refs.text_en: And we sent Timothy, our brother and God's fellow worker in the gospel of Christ, to establish and encourage you for the sake of your faith,

footnotes.en: 5:12 1 testifying Peter was an eyewitness (v. 1), testifying of what he had seen and experienced. He testified that what he wrote in his Epistle as an account of God's grace is true.

footnotes.zh: 神真实的恩典指10节的全般恩典；使徒嘱咐信徒要进入这恩典，并在其中站住。本书主要的是写给受逼迫的信徒，叫他们看见在他们的苦难中神行政的目的。为使他们能经过这些苦难，神要把全般、繁增的恩典，诸般的恩典，和真实的恩典都供应他们(10，一2，四10)。这恩典足能使他们有分于基督的苦难，并为着基督的苦难(二21，三14～17，四12～16)；也要在三一神里成全他们，坚固他们，加强他们，给他们立定根基，还要把他们带进祂永远的荣耀里(10)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神真實的恩典指10節的全般恩典；使徒囑咐信徒要進入這恩典，並在其中站住。本書主要的是寫給受逼迫的信徒，叫他們看見在他們的苦難中神行政的目的。為使他們能經過這些苦難，神要把全般、繁增的恩典，諸般的恩典，和真實的恩典都供應他們。（10，一2，四10。）這恩典足能使他們有分於基督的苦難，並為著基督的苦難；（二21，三14～17，四12～16；）也要在三一神裏成全他們，堅固他們，加強他們，給他們立定根基，還要把他們帶進祂永遠的榮耀裏。（10。）
footnotes.en: 5:12 2 true Referring to the "all grace" in v. 10. The apostle charged the believers to enter into this grace and stand in it. This book was written mainly to show the persecuted believers God's governmental purpose in their sufferings. That they may pass through those sufferings, God supplies them with all the multiplied, varied, and true grace (v. 10; 1:2; 4:10), which is sufficient to enable them to participate in the sufferings of and for Christ (1 Pet. 2:21; 3:14-17; 4:12-16) and which will perfect, establish, strengthen, and ground them in the Triune God and bring them into His eternal glory (v. 10).

footnotes.zh: 历代以来的教师，对这名称持两种不同的解释：一种认为是象征的，指罗马帝国的首都罗马；另一种认为是字面的，指幼发拉底(伯拉)河畔的巴比伦大城。后者的理由比前者更合逻辑。第一，彼得似乎没有理由用象征的名称隐瞒他所在的城市。第二，他书信中所用的都是实在的地名(一1)。第三，在新约中，甚至到了保罗写末了一封书信，提摩太后书时(提后一17)，也许是在彼得前书之后，一直都明确的提到罗马的名称(徒十九21，二八14，16，罗一7，15)。到了主后约九十年，约翰写启示录这本表号的书时，才用大巴比伦这象征的名称指罗马城(启十七5，十八2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 歷代以來的教師，對這名稱持兩種不同的解釋：一種認為是象徵的，指羅馬帝國的首都羅馬；另一種認為是字面的，指幼發拉底（伯拉）河畔的巴比倫大城。後者的理由比前者更合邏輯。第一，彼得似乎沒有理由用象徵的名稱隱瞞他所在的城市。第二，他書信中所用的都是實在的地名。（一1。）第三，在新約中，甚至到了保羅寫末了一封書信，提摩太後書時，（提後一17，）也許是在彼得前書之後，一直都明確的題到羅馬的名稱。（徒十九21，二八14，16，羅一7，15。）到了主後約九十年，約翰寫啟示錄這本表號的書時，纔用大巴比倫這象徵的名稱指羅馬城。（啟十七5，十八2。）
footnotes.en: 5:13 1 co The Greek word and its definite article are feminine. It may refer to Peter's wife, who traveled with him (1 Cor. 9:5), or to a prominent sister in the Lord, who was chosen by God not only with the recipients of this Epistle but also with Peter and all other believers. Some suppose that it refers to the church.

footnotes.zh: 原文及其指定冠词均为阴性，可能是指彼得的妻子，她随着彼得一同往来(林前九5)，或是指主里一位特出的姊妹，她不仅与本书信的受信者一同蒙神拣选，也与彼得和所有其他的信徒同蒙拣选。有些人认为是指召会。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文及其指定冠詞均為陰性，可能是指彼得的妻子，她隨著彼得一同往來，（林前九5，）或是指主裏一位特出的姊妹，她不僅與本書信的受信者一同蒙神揀選，也與彼得和所有其他的信徒同蒙揀選。有些人認為是指召會。
footnotes.en: 5:13 2 Babylon Through the centuries the great teachers have held two different interpretations of this name: that it is figurative, referring to Rome, the capital of the Roman Empire, or that it is literal, referring to Babylon, a large city on the Euphrates (Perath). The reasons for the latter interpretation are more logical than those for the former. First, it seems that Peter had no reason to use a figurative name to hide the name of the city he was in at the time. Second, all the names he used for the places in the address of his Epistle (1 Pet. 1:1) were literal. Third, in the New Testament the name Rome is always clearly mentioned (Acts 19:21; 28:14, 16; Rom. 1:7, 15), even up to the time of the writing of Paul's last Epistle, 2 Timothy (2 Tim. 1:17), which was written probably after 1 Peter. It was when John's Revelation, a book of figures, was written, about A.D. 90, that the figurative name Babylon the Great was used for the city of Rome (Rev. 17:5; 18:2).

refs.text_en: Chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father in the sanctification of the Spirit unto obedience and the sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

refs.text_gb: 唯有你们是蒙拣选的族类，是君尊的祭司体系，是圣别的国度，是买来作产业的子民，要叫你们宣扬那召你们出黑暗、入祂奇妙之光者的美德；
refs.text_big5: 惟有你們是蒙揀選的族類，是君尊的祭司體系，是聖別的國度，是買來作產業的子民，要叫你們宣揚那召你們出黑暗、入祂奇妙之光者的美德；
refs.text_en: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people acquired for a possession, so that you may tell out the virtues of Him who has called you out of darkness into His marvelous light;

refs.text_gb: 问在主里蒙拣选的鲁孚和他母亲，也就是我的母亲安。
refs.text_big5: 問在主裏蒙揀選的魯孚和他母親，也就是我的母親安。
refs.text_en: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother as well as mine.

refs.text_gb: 谁能控告神所拣选的人？有神称我们为义了。
refs.text_big5: 誰能控告神所揀選的人？有神稱我們為義了。
refs.text_en: Who shall bring a charge against God's chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

refs.text_gb: 这圣灵是我们得基业的凭质，为使神所买的产业得赎，使祂的荣耀得着称赞。
refs.text_big5: 這聖靈是我們得基業的憑質，為使神所買的產業得贖，使祂的榮耀得著稱讚。
refs.text_en: Who is the pledge of our inheritance unto the redemption of the acquired possession, to the praise of His glory.

verses.text_gb: 你们要用爱心的[Cra]亲嘴彼此问安。愿[Fn1][Crb]平安归与你们凡[Fn2][Crc]在基督里的人。

verses.text_en: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to you all who are in Christ.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们要用爱心的亲嘴彼此问安。愿平安归与你们凡在基督里的人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要用愛心的親嘴彼此問安。願平安歸與你們凡在基督裏的人。

footnotes.zh: 平安是恩典的结果，来自对三一神的享受。这样享受神作正在繁增并已经繁增的恩典(一2)，诸般的恩典(四10)，全般的恩典(10)，和真实的恩典(12)，作在神行政之下基督徒生活内容的实际，结果产生与神与人都是平安的光景。
footnotes.zh_big5: 平安是恩典的結果，來自對三一神的享受。這樣享受神作正在繁增並已經繁增的恩典，（一2，）諸般的恩典，（四10，）全般的恩典，（10，）和真實的恩典，（12，）作在神行政之下基督徒生活內容的實際，結果產生與神與人都是平安的光景。
footnotes.en: 5:14 1 Peace Peace results from grace and issues from the enjoyment of the Triune God. Such enjoyment of God as the multiplying and multiplied grace (1 Pet. 1:2), the varied grace (1 Pet. 4:10), the all grace (1 Pet. 5:10), and the true grace (1 Pet. 5:12), as the reality of the contents of the Christian life under the government of God, issues and results in a condition of peace with both God and man.

footnotes.zh: 彼得强调信徒在基督里的这个事实(三16，五10)。我们得在基督里是出于神，也是借着我们的相信与受浸(林前一30，约三5，加三27，罗六3)。这就产生与三一神生机的联结(太二八19)，并使我们与主成为一灵(林前六17)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 彼得強調信徒在基督裏的這個事實。（三16，五10。）我們得在基督裏是出於神，也是藉著我們的相信與受浸。（林前一30，約三5，加三27，羅六3。）這就產生與三一神生機的聯結，（太二八19，）並使我們與主成為一靈。（林前六17。）
footnotes.en: 5:14 2 in Peter stressed the fact that the believers are in Christ (1 Pet. 3:16; 5:10). It is of God and through our faith and baptism that we are in Christ (1 Cor. 1:30; John 3:5; Gal. 3:27; Rom. 6:3). This results in an organic union with the Triune God (Matt. 28:19) and makes us one spirit with the Lord (1 Cor. 6:17).
